visual.description: Near-black background used across all page sections and the main canvas.
Pure white used for all headings, large display text, and the logo wordmark.
Light gray used for body copy and paragraph text on dark backgrounds.
Very dark gray used as a subtle surface elevation for code block backgrounds.
Bright green used as the syntax highlight color in the code snippet block.
Deep dark teal radial glow used as the atmospheric background in the hero and CTA footer sections.
Mid-range dark teal forming the outer edge of the radial gradient glow in the hero and footer.
Dark gray used for subtle borders and dividers, including the scrollbar track visible on the right edge.
Off-white used for navigation link text items in the top header.
Pure black used as the transitional background between scroll sections with 3D object imagery.
